caption:
Your review replies are on the clock now too.

BrightLocal's 2026 consumer survey found 19% of people expect a same-day reply to a review, up from 6% last year. Another 32% want an answer by the next day, up from 18%.

Speed alone won't save you. The same research found half of consumers get turned off by generic, copy-paste replies.

The fix: reply inside 24 hours, use the customer's name, name the job, and answer whatever they actually raised. Three real sentences beat a template every time.

DM TRIAL

rationale: Fills the under-served Third-Party Research slot with a fresh, unclaimed BrightLocal 2026 finding on review-response speed and template distrust, distinct from the prior rating-threshold/volume-floor angle.
